description: sig_source_c triangle wave, amplitude 0.7, offset 0.1, phase 0.3

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Piecewise linear in the phase word, exact in both implementations except GNU Radio's float32 arithmetic; measured 0.13 LSB and 109 dB.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Table free waveform: the error is the quantisation of the wave (0.5 LSB rounded, 1 LSB truncated), of the amplitude 0.7 and offset 0.1 constants (0.5 LSB each) and of the product (up to 1 LSB truncated); measured 2.0 LSB at worst.
